notes: Concession rendering is repository-cache-first: browser runtime does not depend on MGU or another single remote GIS endpoint.

Closed/abandoned mining and mining-waste footprints remain in scope independently of whether a concession is currently active.
Sentinel endpoint is defined in the HTML implementation; source manifest records service family rather than credentials/API-specific query.
OSM/developed footprints and legal concession boundaries are deliberately separate geometries.
